compute review_fingerprint over exact run identity/revision + checkpoint run identity/revision + both chronologies/fingerprints + ordered current proposal material-input/proposal fingerprints

authorization: ResolveImportRecovery serializes review_ordinal allocation and appends an immutable import_recovery_review
authorized review permits subsequent per-proposal accept/reject/defer only while its exact review fingerprint remains current
authorization does not accept any proposal or mutate RFC/WFM/Task authority

proposal acceptance rechecks both domain base-state token and recovery authorization fingerprint inside its UnitOfWork

idempotency: Replaying the same recovery-review/finalization command_id/request hash returns the committed result. A later distinct review appends a new ordinal; it never overwrites prior review or recovery evidence.
